confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable for a Cretan tourist town in July. Accommodation anchors are least certain because peak-July rates vary widely by season, location, and booking lead time. Drink prices are estimated from typical Chania tourist-area pricing relative to beer. FX: the RBA observation below is the most recent one I could attribute to the official RBA table (20 March 2026, as listed on the RBA exchange-rates page in search results). It is stale relative to the 16 October 2026 reference date. A third-party site reported a later rate, but I could not confirm it against the RBA table, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The estimate is a holistic blend of Crete's other tourist hubs (Rethymno, Heraklion) and mid-sized Mediterranean resort towns with similar July demand, with Chania's old-town and Venetian-harbour dining and lodging pressure weighted in.
